title: Constraints on the Physical Origin of Large Cavities in Transition Disks from Multiwavelength Dust Continuum Emission

recipe.goal: Self-calibrate ALMA data and obtain calibrated VLA data
recipe.method: Iterative phase self-calibration with decreasing solution interval, then one amplitude self-cal; calibrated VLA data taken from Disks@EVLA
key_parameters: Iterate while SNR improves by at least 5%; solint decreases by a factor of 3 per iteration

recipe.method: CASA tclean, multi-scale CLEAN, mask on disk emission
key_parameters: Scales: point source, 1, 2, 3 times beam FWHM; robust 0.5 (ALMA) / 2.0 (VLA)

recipe.goal: Extract visibilities, de-project, and fit disk center and geometry
recipe.method: De-project visibilities by rotating baselines by the PA and stretching along the minor axis by cos(i); fit inclination/PA by minimizing visibility scatter in annuli; fit center by minimizing imaginary part or a 2D Gaussian on a tapered image
key_parameters: Geometry fixed for all wavelengths of a disk, taken from Band 6, 3, 6, 7, 6, 6 for CQTau, UXTau A, LkCa15, RXJ1615, SR24S, DMTau

recipe.goal: Fit non-parametric radial brightness profiles to visibilities
recipe.method: Frankenstein fit of the real part of the de-projected visibilities (Fourier-Bessel series) in logarithmic brightness space; hyper-parameters alpha and w_smooth chosen by visual inspection from a grid
key_parameters: Grid of alpha = 1.05-1.30 and log10(w_smooth) = -4 to -1; chosen pairs per dataset in the visibility table
Fit in logarithmic brightness space; low-SNR VLA data fitted on visibilities binned at 10 klambda
assumptions: Imaginary part of the visibilities not used because of the azimuthal symmetry assumption

recipe.goal: Fit parametric models to VLA visibilities
recipe.method: Sum of Gaussian rings at fixed radii plus a central point source (free-free), visibilities via Hankel transform, fitted to the non-binned VLA visibilities
key_parameters: 64 walkers and 10000 steps; ring radii fixed from ALMA profiles (RXJ1615 outer ring radius free)
assumptions: Emission from spinning nanometer-size dust does not contribute

recipe.goal: Build common-resolution radial profiles with uncertainties
recipe.method: Image-plane profiles from GoFish for comparison; visibility-fit profiles convolved to the lowest resolution of each disk; azimuthal-asymmetry errors from the image plane added in quadrature to the visibility-fit errors; intrinsic resolution of each fit from delta-ring tests
key_parameters: Band 9 data excluded from the multi-wavelength analysis, and low-resolution datasets excluded
assumptions: Filling factor of 1 everywhere for image-plane profiles

recipe.goal: Fit the multi-wavelength SED at each radius
recipe.method: Fit intensity of a scattering-corrected emergent-intensity model at each radius for maximum grain size, dust surface density and dust temperature
key_parameters: 24 walkers and 10000 steps; log-spaced ranges 300 um <= a_max <= 30 cm, 1e-6 <= Sigma_d <= 10 g cm^-2, 3 <= T_d <= 300 K
Absolute flux uncertainty 5% (Bands 3, 4), 10% (Bands 6, 7), 20% (Bands 8, 9) included in the intensity errors
assumptions: Particle size distribution n(a) ~ a^-p with p fixed to 3.0 and minimum grain size 0.05 um
Opacities and albedo from Birnstiel et al. 2018; spherical compact grains
Temperature prior centered on a passively irradiated disk with width 50 K

recipe.method: Integrate the fitted dust surface density profiles

recipe.goal: Test radial smearing on the inferred dust properties
recipe.method: Build a DMTau-like model profile, compute convolved intensities at the observed bands, refit the SED and compare to the input convolved profiles
key_parameters: Model convolved at the DMTau resolution of 120 mas

recipe.goal: Compare dust property profiles with cavity-origin signatures
recipe.method: Qualitative comparison of Sigma_d, a_max and T_d profiles (peaks at ring, decreasing a_max with radius) with signatures of dust traps vs grain growth plus pressure bump, combined with literature gas cavities

score_reason: Data are public and the main modeling steps (Frankenstein hyper-parameters, SED model, ranges, MCMC sizes, flux errors) are given, but initial calibration, imaging masks, line-free channels and several priors are unstated, and the work spans 26 datasets.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA and VLA data, a mostly complete visibility-modeling and SED-fitting recipe, and numeric outputs (ring radii, dust masses, free-free fluxes), though it is a heavy multi-dataset job.
